ns2:course.label: Law and School District Leader
ns2:course.description: Advanced study of public school law, addressing legal and fiscal policy issues related to effective management of public school districts. In-depth analysis of federal and state statutes, with an emphasis on recent court decisions and legal trends; emphasizes development of legal analytical skills. Same as EPOL 546. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Same as EPOL 546. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit.
